name: rtl-text
description: Shapes and reorders Persian, Arabic and Hebrew text in the transcript through fribidi so the terminal draws it joined, right-to-left and right-aligned.

alignment.title: Alignment
alignment.description: auto: right-align RTL paragraphs; left: shape only; right: always right-align

margin.title: Right margin (cells)
margin.description: Cells subtracted from viewport.columns before wrapping; keep it >= 1, it is the slack that stops wrap:truncate-end cutting the start of a right-aligned RTL line

timeoutMs.title: fribidi timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: Milliseconds a fribidi call may take before it is killed and the row falls back to the engine's own drawing

replyBullet.title: Reply bullet
replyBullet.description: Marker drawn on the opening line of a reply, replacing the one the engine draws; empty string for none
